title: kbtail.py replays a replaced smaller transcript whole and reads a replaced larger one from the old byte offset
goal: kbtail.py notices a followed transcript replaced by another file (smaller or larger) and shows the new file's last --history lines and what is appended after, losing no line and replaying none

run:
import json, os, subprocess, sys, tempfile, threading, time, uuid
R = os.getcwd(); T = tempfile.mkdtemp(); C = os.path.join(T, "cfg")
sid = str(uuid.uuid4())
pdir = os.path.join(C, "projects", "-planted-project"); os.makedirs(pdir)
P = os.path.join(pdir, sid + ".jsonl")
env = dict(os.environ, CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=C, COLUMNS="200", KB_COORD_STORE=os.path.join(T, "coord.sqlite"))
def ent(text, **kw):
    return json.dumps(dict({"type": "assistant", "cwd": T, "sessionId": sid, "timestamp": "2026-10-26T10:00:00Z",
                            "message": {"role": "assistant", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": text}]}}, **kw)) + "\n"
def tail(*a, path=None):
    return subprocess.run([sys.executable, "_tools/kbtail.py", *a, path or P], cwd=R, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
def follow(path=None):
    p = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, "_tools/kbtail.py", "--history", "2", path or P], cwd=R, env=env,
                         stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True)
    lines = []
    threading.Thread(target=lambda: [lines.append(x) for x in p.stdout], daemon=True).start()
    return p, lines
def until(pred, s):
    end = time.monotonic() + s
    while time.monotonic() < end and not pred():
        time.sleep(0.05)
    return pred()
with open(P, "w") as f:
    for i in range(30):
        f.write(ent("old%d" % i))
p, lines = follow()
until(lambda: any("old29" in x for x in lines), 10)
new = P + ".new"
with open(new, "w") as f:
    for i in range(60):
        f.write(ent("big%d" % i))
os.replace(new, P)
until(lambda: any("big59" in x for x in lines), 5)
small = P + ".small"
with open(small, "w") as f:
    for i in range(30):
        f.write(ent("small%d" % i))
os.replace(small, P)
until(lambda: any("small29" in x for x in lines), 5)
p.terminate(); p.wait(5)
out = "".join(lines)
import re as _re
nums = lambda w: {int(n) for n in _re.findall(r"\b" + w + r"(\d+)\b", out)}
small_shown = len(nums("small"))
problems = []
if not {58, 59} <= nums("big"):
    problems.append("the replacing larger file's last lines are not shown")
if small_shown > 2:
    problems.append("the replacing smaller file is replayed whole (%d lines, --history 2)" % small_shown)
print("\n".join(problems) or "ok")
sys.exit(1 if problems else 0)
